Layer.DiffUpdateMessageCommand: %function(self) local songg = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() if songg then local StepsList = songg:GetStepsByStepsType(GAMESTATE:PlayerUsingBothSides() and 1 or 0) local DiffList = {} for index, steps in ipairs(StepsList) do DiffList[steps:GetDifficulty()] = steps:GetMeter() end ToHoSokuGlob.CurDiffList = DiffList else ToHoSokuGlob.CurDiffList = {} end end

Layer.TextUpdateMessageCommand: %function(self) local songg = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() if songg then self:settext(GetStepsDescriptionText(PLAYER_1)) else self:settext('') end end
%function(self) local stepp = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSteps(PLAYER_1) if stepp then self:settext(DifficultyToThemedString(stepp:GetDifficulty())..' '..stepp:GetMeter()) else self:settext('') end end
%function(self) local songg = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() if songg then self:settext(GetStepsDescriptionText(PLAYER_2)) else self:settext('') end end
%function(self) local stepp = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSteps(PLAYER_2) if stepp then self:settext(DifficultyToThemedString(stepp:GetDifficulty())..' '..stepp:GetMeter()) else self:settext('') end end

Layer.DiffUpdateMessageCommand: %function(self) local TheList = ToHoSokuGlob.CurDiffList if TheList and TheList[0] then self:settext(TheList[0]) self:diffuse(0.04,1,0.06,1) else self:settext('') end end
